hints.title: Day of Week Classification
hints.text: Determine the day of week for assign_date. Weekend days are Saturday and Sunday.

hints.title: Conditional Counting
hints.text: Sum 1 when the day of week falls on a weekend, and sum 1 when it falls on a weekday.

hints.title: Single-Row Aggregation
hints.text: Produce a single row containing weekend_cnt and working_cnt columns.

hints.title: Conditional Day Sum Query
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(assign_date) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(assign_date) < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS working_cnt
FROM Tasks;
```

complexity.time: O(n) linear scan over tasks table
complexity.notes: Conditional sum over all rows produces single aggregated summary row.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running two separate queries with union is redundant when conditional aggregation computes both in one pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles weekend identification using dialect-appropriate day-of-week functions.

solutions.code:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(assign_date) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(assign_date) < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS working_cnt
FROM Tasks;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM assign_date) IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INT AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM assign_date) NOT IN (0, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INT AS working_cnt
FROM Tasks;
